newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: FORECAST - Pakhoed net seen just higher.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Pakhoed net seen just higher.

text.p: Dutch tank storage and shipping firm Koninklijke Pakhoed NV is expected to report modestly higher 1996 profit on Tuesday, after second half improvement, analysts said this week.
Forecasts for net profit excluding extraordinaries ranged from 125 million guilders to 140 million guilders, against 1995 net of 123.6 million guilders.

In August, the company said net profit from ordinary operations in the second half of 1996 would be "clearly higher" than that in the second half of 1995 because of restructuring in its Rotterdam tank storage operations and the takeover of U.S. chemicals distributor Univar Corp.
